component.name: Boost.Multiprecision
component.purpose: C++20 exact video-retime rational arithmetic; no Boost library or header is a separately loadable runtime payload.

headerClosure.policy: Resolve every syntactic Boost include independent of preprocessor branches, sort paths, and digest each path, byte length, and SHA-256 through scripts/lib/boost-header-closure.mjs.

packaging.reason: The closure is compile-time input for native media host builds. This record does not claim that a host payload has been built or shipped.
